card.title: More Official Than You
card.instruction: Turn every suggestion into a contest over whose method, title, precedent, or paperwork is more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your bow at the ceremony was adequate. Mine follows the founder's original diagram.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The founder asked us to wave instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: His original diagram is in the constitution. My bow follows that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you have a signed exception. I'll bow on behalf of everyone still governed by the constitution.

mechanism: A insists constitutional ceremony outranks even the founder's newer personal request by classifying that request as an individual exception.
confusable: Unlike mere attachment to a custom, A must use formal legitimacy to outbid each competing authority.
comparison: A signed programme is demoted below a constitution, unlike a useful picnic rota being annexed to committee paperwork.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
